chunks.text: Then there's the magnetism at the Sun's poles.
Some scientists read it as an early sign of how strong the next round will be, and right now it's weak.
Does that mean a weak round twenty-six?
A team led by a scientist named Wang looked at exactly that question.
In July twenty twenty-six, they reported that it's unlikely to mean an exceptionally weak one.
They didn't give a number either.
